character.lede: A mid-century desert villa has split dark-tile roofs over caramel stucco and a glass-roofed conservatory on the corner. A walled resort garden wraps a turtle-mosaic pool, with a deck and a firepit.

spots.line: A trestle table, eight chairs and a fireplace sit under glass.
A record player stands beside the bed.
A house bed, a small desk and an easel share the room.

facts.style: Mid-century desert villa: split dark-tile shed roofs with thick rust fascias over caramel stucco, a glass-roofed conservatory dining room on the street corner, a vertical-timber tower, a recessed double-door entry under a slatted canopy, one-bay garage; a walled resort garden round a turtle-mosaic pool

character.truths: The Core sits on a credenza in the Living Room. There is no television and no kitchen island. Pool, deck, firepit, swing set and pergolas in a walled garden. The conservatory dining room has a fireplace.

details.rule: every beat of an adult or teen persona (13 or older) gets a detail (before, after, steps, fact); pair beats first

onlyoffice: [note] This is the Desktop Editors suite (Writer, Calc, Impress, PDF editor) in a browser session. ONLYOFFICE Document Server and ONLYOFFICE Workspace are different listings; name this one in full. LibreOffice does the s
[note] amd64 only. One access password set at install; the container includes a privileged desktop environment, so do not call it sandboxed.
marketplace: e2e/screenshots/onlyoffice.png shows ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) not Desktop Editors.
libretranslate: [note] Works offline once language models are downloaded.
Listing says "works fully offline": banned wording (sec-offline)
Likely already heavy in the existing stories
navidrome: Description says "from anywhere" and "works offline-first": paraphrase, remote access is not claimed
Already in 11 of 30 stories: one short of the cap of 12; rotate music beats to mStream, Swing Music and Music Assistant
homehub: No passwords: a "Select your user" box offers every name including Administrator (anyone on the network can pick one)
Extras bundled: recipes, expiry tracker, link shortener, PDF compressor, QR generator
nextcloud: [note] The Hub onboarding wizard offers Nextcloud as a recommended app.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
ntfy: [cloud-link] iOS push goes through an upstream relay setting; Android and web can stay local.
No sign-in is configured: anyone who can reach the URL can publish and subscribe. Keep it on the home network.
iOS push goes through an upstream relay setting; Android and web can stay local.
QA screenshot is an empty app with a notifications-blocked banner (shows the product).
steam-headless: [cloud-link] Steam needs a Valve account to sign in, and the game library and the purchases are Valve's. The Core runs the session; the account stays with Valve. Say that, never "no account".

[hardware] The listing asks for GPU passthrough for best performance and the Hub package declares no GPU device, so a given Core may not run a given game well. Say what the Core does (it runs the session at home), never

[claims] No frame rate, resolution or latency figure, and not "smooth". Never "gaming PC", "console replacement" or "cloud gaming replacement" in the text. The chip may read "replaces GeForce Now" or "replaces Xbox Cloud

[note] It shows a streamed desktop with sound in a browser (noVNC), so the screen needs a browser, not a console. The container runs privileged with host access: do not call it sandboxed. Keep the stream on the home netw
[note] Persona decision 2026-10-15 (Liam Broza): re-admitted from the old cloud-account exclusion for the gamer archetype, with the caveats above.
vaultwarden: [note] Bitwarden-compatible server, unofficial. Do not say "Bitwarden".
librephotos: [note] First setup takes 5 to 10 minutes while models and migrations start.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
Face recognition is sensitive: say what it does, never that it "knows" people
Overlaps Immich; use it to relieve Immich's share
searxng: [cloud-link] It queries outside search engines for you. Say "private search", not "offline search".
cloud-link: the engines still see the query from the Core
listing says users are not tracked: do not repeat
calibre-web: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
marketplace: Documented default admin credentials (admin / admin123); no QA capture.
audiomass: The Core only serves the page: decoded audio and edits live in the viewer's browser, so "sits on the Core" is false until the person saves a file where they choose
Short description says "audio never leaves the appliance": an absolute; paraphrase
baikal: Whoever opens the app first runs the install wizard and sets the admin password
Overlaps Radicale and Nextcloud calendars: one calendar server per household
excalidraw: [note] amd64 only. An Excalidraw MCP entry exists for agents.
marketplace: Manifest source points to ozencb/excalidraw-persist, a 105-star wrapper, not excalidraw/excalidraw.
whisper-webui: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Model weights download from the internet on first use.
YouTube URL input, DeepL translation and pyannote diarization models are outside services or accounts: leave out.
Open access on the LAN unless a username and password are set.
syncthing: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
obsidian: [licence] Obsidian is not open source. Do not call it open source.
[note] An Obsidian MCP entry exists so an agent can read and write the vault.
not open source (catalog: never say so)
listing says private and offline: do not repeat
notes are files on the Core, the app is streamed
blockbench: Projects live in the browser (IndexedDB) or in files the person saves: the Core serves the app, it does not hold the models
The listing names Minecraft models; say "game models" or "block models" in copy
Free-text store claim "never sees your models" is accurate for the container
habitica: The sign-up page in the capture carries a cookie-consent banner: check the self-hosted build for analytics scripts before saying it sends nothing out
Game, not a health or behaviour tool: no outcomes
kokoro: [note] OpenAI-compatible speech API. No GPU requirement in the listing.
OpenAI-compatible speech API; web player included.
No GPU requirement in the listing; no speed claim.
Capture is real (FastKoko player) on a dark purple background.
koodo-reader: marketplace: Listing text says nothing is sent to a cloud service; the reader has outside-calling features (translation, lookup, speech).
bentopdf: Dual licence: AGPL-3.0 or paid commercial; fine for household use
Listing says "nothing to leak": drop that wording
airtrail: Logbook and statistics, not live flight tracking (listing short_desc says "flight tracking")
Does not claim live flight status; story must say logbook
solidtime: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
listing mentions invoices: say nothing about billing or tax
